_status: DOCUMENTATION OF A SHAPE — no validator reads this file. Nothing in this engine imports jsonschema; the invariants are enforced in code by classification.validate_header, doc_manifest and export_sanitizer. Labelled here 2026-08-22 because OG-39 closed NOT_A_DEFECT on the reasoning that these files were 'labelled as such at their point of use', and they were not (OG-91).
title: ContentIndex
description: Machine-readable index of the currently-available (authored) PUBLIC documents, emitted by tools/docgen/build_index.py build_content_index(). A future graphify pass or the app docs page consumes this instead of re-parsing Markdown. Leak-safe (RULEBOOK L14): only classification:public entries are ever listed by id/title/path; non-public authored docs are counted in aggregate but never named.

schema.description: Schema id + version. Bumped only on a breaking shape change.

manifest.description: Repo-relative path of the DOC_MANIFEST.md the index was built from.

docs_root.description: Repo-relative path of the authored-docs root scanned for .md sources.

public.description: Number of authored PUBLIC docs listed in entries[].

non_public_excluded.description: Authored docs whose header tier is confidential/secret; counted but NEVER named (L14 leak-safety).

manifest_rows.description: Number of DOC_MANIFEST.md type rows the index was grouped against.

entries.description: One row per authored PUBLIC document, sorted by id (deterministic).

tier.description: Always 'public' — only public docs are listed (L14).

type_prefix.description: The doc-type prefix extracted from the id (e.g. 'WF'), matching a DOC_MANIFEST.md / TAXONOMY.md row when known, else '(unlisted)'.

surface.description: Where the doc may render (from its header).

path.description: Repo-relative path of the authored .md source.

status.description: The doc header's status (e.g. 'draft', 'published'). May be empty.
